titles.romaji: Eguchi Hisashi no Kotobuki Gorou Show
titles.native: 江口寿史の寿五郎ショウ

description:
Based on the gag manga by Hisashi Eguchi.

Episode 1 is about the vulgar family trying to get their daughter married. Episode 2 is about the vulgar family and the hardships of married life. Episode 3 is about a boxer who can only lose weight by abstaining from sex. Episode 4 is about giant monsters.

Note: Originally released as a feature part of Studio Pierrot's video magazine show Anime V Comic Rentaman (アニメ・V・コミック レンタマン) along with Abashiri Ikka, Yumemakura Baku Twilight Gekijou and Akai Hayate.
